engine.cocos.variant.title: Cocos variant: {variant}
engine.cocos.variant.summary: Cocos family variant {variant} (version hint: {version}), from file / directory layout markers.

engine.script.encrypted.title: {engine} script protection
engine.script.encrypted.summary: {engine}: {total} script file(s) ({sampled} examined): {plain} plain, {bytecode} bytecode, {compressed} compressed, {suspected} suspected encrypted or obfuscated. Bytecode, compression and minification are not encryption; high entropy alone is not proof.
engine.script.encrypted.remediation: Encrypted scripts need the key held by the app; this tool only reports the protection and never extracts keys or decrypts.

engine.resource.encrypted.title: {engine} resource protection
engine.resource.encrypted.summary: {engine}: {sampled} resource file(s) examined; {encrypted} use a container that is encrypted by definition (e.g. CCZp), {suspected} are suspected encrypted or custom-wrapped, {plain} are standard / plain. Files whose extension does not match their content and that share a custom header indicate a custom wrapper; no vendor is asserted.
engine.resource.encrypted.remediation: Resource keys are held by the app; this tool only reports the protection.

engine.pak.encrypted.title: {engine} package encryption
engine.pak.encrypted.summary: {engine}: {containers} resource container(s) examined, {encrypted} with an encryption flag, {unknown} could not be judged (truncated or unrecognised). A missing index-encryption flag does not prove that every entry is unencrypted.
engine.pak.encrypted.remediation: Encrypted packages need the AES key held by the app; this tool does not extract keys.

engine.hermes.title: Hermes bytecode
engine.hermes.summary: {engine}: {bundles} JS bundle(s); Hermes bytecode: {hermes} (bytecode version: {version}). Bytecode is compiled code, not encryption.

engine.flutter_aot.title: Flutter AOT snapshot
engine.flutter_aot.summary: {engine}: AOT snapshot: {aot} (Dart version hint: {dart_version}, {assets} flutter_assets files). AOT is compiled code, not encryption.
